## Description

Formulates distributionally robust portfolio optimization by combining Wasserstein ambiguity sets with Riemannian manifold metric gradient descent on Symmetric Positive Definite covariance spaces.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, severe market stress, robust multi-asset allocation mandates.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Risk-Parity Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Historical asset return panels, covariance matrices, Wasserstein ambiguity radius parameters.

## Caveats

Combines convex conic optimization with non-Euclidean manifold operations, requiring specialized solvers.
